ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.SW_Bypass_Validation_Rules <> TRUE, ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Working"), OR( ISBLANK(Email), ISBLANK(Phone), ISBLANK(Street), ISBLANK(City), ISBLANK(State), ISBLANK(PostalCode), ISBLANK(Country), ISPICKVAL(Industry, ""), ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill Email, Phone, Address, Industry and Lead Source before moving the status to Working.
